pages.title: A Trophy Put to Work
pages.text: Use one obtained beast trophy in its actual active context.

pages.title: A Trophy Put to Work
pages.text: Match a trophy to water, cold or a particular combat trigger.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Hold Yeti Horn offhand in cold biomes for recovery, or Viper Tooth underwater for sight and defense. Magic Root slows after a hit, Gator Tooth has a poison chance, and Jungle Pendant has a resistance chance after kills. Choose one actual effect, not any hit with any trophy.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Yeti Horn needs a cold biome and offhand; the pendant has a chance after kills.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Executioner Hood grants temporary strength after kills; Molten Coal works offhand while burning.
